thread:
maria: Originate RC candidate v2.7.0-rc3. Planning a shadow eval against prod traffic for 2h during quiet window 22:00-00:00 PST. Need rollback playbook, artifact pin, and denylist check. @deploy-bot can you schedule?

deploy-bot: scheduled shadow evaluation for rc=v2.7.0-rc3, start=2026-03-23T22:00Z, duration=2h, sample=5% read-only. Canary disabled for shadow. Logs: /logs/shadow/7801234567

jorge: Ack. Can we get QA signoff on regression set A and a perf sweep? Sasha, you good to run those?

sasha: K running regression A + perf now. Quick heads up: p50 latency up ~4% on long-form prompts in local perf. I'll post diffs to the eval doc and the important snapshots here. Will approve if no correctness regressions.

alex: Oncall ok for quiet window. What are our explicit rollback triggers? Need thresholds so alerts are actionable.

maria: Rollback criteria drafted: 1) QoS errors >1% sustained for 5m, 2) latency p95 increase >20% sustained 10m, 3) >=3 user-facing regression failures on smoke set. Rollback command (manual):
```
./deploy rollback --pin redwood-inference:v2.7.0-rc2 --reason "rc3 regression"
```
Also planning an automated deadman alert if any of the above fire.

jorge: Add model-hash pin too. We should ensure binary/artifact pin and model checksum are both recorded. Artifact pin command: 
```
./deploy pin --artifact redwood-inference:v2.7.0-rc3 --sha256 abc123def456...
```

sasha: QA checklist I'm running: smoke, streaming responses, function/tool-calls, embeddings, rerank tests. ETA ~40m. If snapshots are clean, I will +1 for canary.

maria: Release notes draft exists: https://go/release-notes/internal/v2.7.0-rc3 (internal). Add any user-impacting changes or known regressions.

deploy-bot: shadow eval started (ts=7801234570). traffic_sample=5% read-only. logs=/logs/shadow/7801234567. Notifying telemetry.

jorge: If shadow looks good, plan: pin at 00:10 PST, then canary 5% for 30m, then 30% for 60m, then full promote if no issues. Any objections?

alex: fine by oncall. I'll set alerts for QoS errors and p95 latency, and keep a pager watch during the canary window.

sasha: QA snapshots green. No functional diffs on core intents. Latency regression is limited to one rare prompt fingerprint (p95 +12%). I think it passes our tolerance given feature uplift. +1 from QA.

maria: OK. @deploy-bot run pin and schedule canary per Jorge's plan. Also add a denylist for the experimental opcode that caused flaky streaming in dev.

deploy-bot: pin applied: artifact=redwood-inference:v2.7.0-rc3, pinned_by=maria, ts=7801234590. model_sha=abc123def456... Canary scheduled: start=7801234620, phase1=5%:30m -> phase2=30%:60m. Denylist applied: streaming.opcode.experimental=true

jorge: Promotion target set and release notes updated. If no rollback during canary, we'll promote at end of phase2. I'll take stewardship for the promo.

alex: Oncall will monitor dashboards and post a final green at end of canary. If anything trips thresholds we execute rollback command above and notify execs.

maria: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open for post-canary readout.
